title:
Optimized enzymatic colorimetric assay for determination of hydrogen
peroxide (H2O2) scavenging activity of plant
extracts
author: Fernando, Soysa

steps.title: Wash and dry plant material
steps.instruction: Wash each plant material (A. ceylanica leaves, E. quinquangulare whole plant, M. cerviana whole plant, S. parvifolia leaves) sequentially with tap water, then distilled water, then de‑ionized water; dry until a constant weight is reached.

steps.title: Grind plant material to powder
steps.instruction: Cut the dried plant material into small pieces and grind to a fine powder using a clean kitchen blender.

steps.title: Extract plant powders with water
steps.instruction: For each plant (except S. parvifolia) weigh 30 g of powder, add 800 mL de‑ionized water in a beaker and boil until the volume is reduced to 100 mL (1/8 of the original). For S. parvifolia, reflux 30 g powder with 800 mL de‑ionized water.

steps.title: Clarify extracts
steps.instruction: Sonicate each decoction, filter first through a cotton‑wool plug and then through Whatman No. 1 filter paper.

steps.title: Centrifuge and freeze‑dry extracts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrates at 2000 rpm for 10 min; collect the supernatants, freeze‑dry them, weigh the dry material and store at –20 °C in sterile tubes until use.

steps.title: Prepare black tea infusion (optional control)
steps.instruction: Add 2.0 g C. sinensis (black tea powder) to 200 mL boiling water, let stand in a closed beaker, cool to room temperature, filter through Whatman No. 1 paper, and keep the filtrate for experiments.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixture
steps.instruction: In separate tubes (one for each incubation time 5–60 min) combine: phenol 12 mM (350 µL), 4‑aminoantipyrene 0.5 mM (100 µL), H₂O₂ 0.7 mM (160 µL), and phosphate buffer pH 7, 84 mM (350 µL).

steps.title: Add HRP and incubate
steps.instruction: Add HRP (final concentration 1 U mL⁻¹; 40 µL of a 1 U mL⁻¹ stock) to each tube and incubate at 37 °C. The optimal incubation time is 30 min (stable colour up to 60 min).

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: At the end of each incubation period read the absorbance at 504 nm against a reagent blank containing phosphate buffer instead of phenol.

steps.title: Optimize HRP concentration (optional)
steps.instruction: Prepare reaction mixtures as above and add HRP at concentrations ranging from 0.01 to 1 U mL⁻¹; incubate 30 min at 37 °C and record absorbance to determine the optimal enzyme amount (0.1 U mL⁻¹ gave suitable colour, 1 U mL⁻¹ used to offset possible inhibition).

steps.title: Optimize H₂O₂ concentration (optional)
steps.instruction: Using the optimal HRP (1 U mL⁻¹), prepare reaction mixtures with H₂O₂ concentrations from 0.175 to 0.70 mM; incubate 30 min at 37 °C, read absorbance and select 0.70 mM as the assay concentration (enzyme saturation point).
